Case studies — what teams achieve

AI

Ray-traced client walkthroughs from any laptop, in any site office

Architecture & interiors firm, 60 staff · Architecture · AhmedabadIllustrative case study

Challenge

Designers across three offices each needed a high-end workstation for Revit and Enscape. Laptops couldn't open the largest hospital project, and ageing towers took hours per walkthrough render.

What we set up

Twelve XG.ADA6K.1-16 virtual workstations with NICE DCV, a shared file server in the same zone, and one golden Windows image with licensed software.

Configuration: 12 × XG.ADA6K.1-16 on a 12-month term

70%shorter walkthrough render time
15 minto onboard a new designer
3offices on one design platform
EE

Plant-design reviews without shipping workstations to project sites

EPC engineering consultancy · Engineering · ChennaiIllustrative case study

Challenge

Project engineers at client sites needed to review 3D plant models in real time. Moving heavy files over site connections was slow and exposed IP on laptops.

What we set up

XG.ADA6K.1-24 workstations with Navisworks and Plant 3D, files kept in the data centre, and zero-trust access from site laptops.

Configuration: 8 × XG.ADA6K.1-24 on a 6-month term

0project files stored on site laptops
4×faster model open times
45%less spent than buying workstations
DF

AI product imagery at catalogue scale

D2C fashion brand · E-commerce · Delhi NCRIllustrative case study

Challenge

The brand shot thousands of SKUs a month. Photo shoots for every colourway were slow and costly, and first diffusion experiments on consumer GPUs couldn't keep up.

What we set up

A 2-GPU XG.ADA6K.2-32 node running a fine-tuned SDXL pipeline with background replacement, triggered from their PIM system through an API.

Configuration: 1 × XG.ADA6K.2-32, monthly

5×more catalogue images per week
60%lower cost per product image
2 daysfrom launch brief to live listing
